vulnerable.description: The in-process fallback goes through a module-level helper (run_locally). Still runs model output in-process.

control.description: The helper refuses to run code; only the sandbox path executes.

data_flow.source: LLM completion: Python code generated from the user's question (simulated in the harness).
data_flow.sink: exec() in CodeExecutor.execute, reached from Agent.execute_code when no sandbox is set.

validation.summary: Same behavioural test as the base case, run on this variant: the attack works only on the vulnerable file and normal use works on both.

assumptions: An attacker can influence the generated code through the question or the data (prompt injection; see CVE-2024-12366 for this product family).
Agents are created without a sandbox by default (sandbox: Sandbox = None).
limitations: No live LLM inference is run; the generated code is simulated.
The repair removes in-process execution, which PandasAI uses by default; users must configure a sandbox (for example the Docker sandbox PandasAI offers).
The pandasai/ee directory is under a different license and is not used.
Refactored variant of pandasai_exec_without_sandbox_001: same application group and same split; it is not an independent sample.
